necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, as documented in the clinical indication note. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was specifically ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess for potential hemodynamic compromise. This direct correlation between the patient's reported symptoms and the diagnostic utility of the service supports the medical necessity denied under code CO-50.
